zg361_sb_m_01_select_gui = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = {
		has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_char
		has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_rank
		has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_case_owner
		has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_cycle_serial
		has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_case_serial
	}
	effect = {
		zg361_clear_scoreboard_detail_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_source value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_slot value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_char value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_char }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_title }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_title value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_title }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_rank value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_rank }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_case_owner } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_case_owner value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_case_owner } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_cycle_serial } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_cycle_serial value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_cycle_serial } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_case_serial } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_case_serial value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_case_serial } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_kpi_frozen } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_kpi_frozen value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_kpi_frozen } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_values_frozen } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_values_frozen value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_values_frozen } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_governance } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_evidence_governance value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_governance } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_capability } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_evidence_capability value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_capability } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_growth } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_evidence_growth value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_growth } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_superior } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_evidence_superior value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_superior } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_values } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_evidence_values value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_values } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_collaboration } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_evidence_collaboration value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_collaboration } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_jingcha } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_evidence_jingcha value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_jingcha } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_organization } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_evidence_organization value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_evidence_organization } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_cohort_n } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_cohort_n value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_cohort_n } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_absolute_grade } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_absolute_grade value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_absolute_grade } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_final_grade } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_final_grade value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_final_grade } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_grade_reason } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_grade_reason value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_grade_reason } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_case_state } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_case_state value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_case_state } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_delivery_method } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_delivery_method value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_delivery_method } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_appeal_open } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_appeal_open value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_appeal_open } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = zg361_sb_m_01_appeal_outcome } set_variable = { name = zg361_sb_detail_appeal_outcome value = var:zg361_sb_m_01_appeal_outcome } }
